chunks: Jamil ibn Darraj narrated from Isma'il ibn Jabir al-Ju'fi, from Abu Ja'far عليه السلام, who said:

There are five who may be divorced in any condition: the pregnant woman whose pregnancy has become evident, the woman with whom her husband has not consummated the marriage, the woman whose husband is absent from her, the woman who has not menstruated, and the woman who has ceased menstruating.
ai.seo_question: Which women can be divorced in any condition according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning five categories of women for whom divorce may be effected in any condition. It outlines specific exceptions in family law related to pregnancy, non-consummation, absence of the husband, lack of menstruation, and menopause.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4808 - Jamil ibn Darraj narrated from Isma'il ibn Jabir Al-Ju'fi, from Abu Ja'far Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), who said:

"There are five types of women who can be divorced in any condition:
the pregnant woman whose pregnancy is evident,
the woman whose husband has not consummated the marriage with her,
the woman whose husband is absent,
the woman who does not menstruate,
And the woman who has ceased menstruating."
